english.notes:
(i) This offence wording may be used for an offence in connection with a prohibition or restriction on importation or exportation having effect by virtue of Regulation 2 of the Seal Skins Regulations 1996.
(ii) See section 171 for general provisions as to offences and penalties.
(iii) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions

other.powersofarrest:
Subsection 170(2) provides:

Without prejudice to any other provision of the Customs and Excise Acts 1979, if a person is, in relation to any goods, in any way knowingly concerned in any fraudulent evasion or attempt at evasion:

(a) of duty chargeable on the goods;
(b) of a prohibition or restriction in force on the goods under any legislation; or
(c) of a provision of the Customs and Excise Acts 1979 applicable to them,

he is guilty of an offence and may be arrested.
other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,000.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.
